verdict.rationale: Skyfire holds account, wallet, and transaction data, so a data-export-and-leave story is a fair question for it. The pack documents no export or bulk-download capability, and no account-closure flow aimed at data portability. The open KYAPay JWT token format, the wallet-balance API, and account deactivation are adjacent features or building blocks, not a documented way to export all your data in open formats.
